notes.title: Huge new Table Manners patch now available
notes.notes:
Hello again, Table Manners players!

Echo Chamber Games here. Thank you so much for all your feedback so far - both good and bad! It's been incredibly helpful for the team to see what's working well, and what we need to take a closer look at.

We're super pleased to say our patch is now live, which addresses the following:
 Controller support is here! Once you've passed the initial setup screen, just plug in an Xbox or PS4 controller to start playing. Controller keys can binded on the settings menu. You can find the default bindings below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/b18c07267130079c41756d91f3bea5c0e6397186.png

 We’ve fixed lots of bug and crash errors, including item respawns and missing animations. If you launch your newly updated game and your customisation items are missing, fear not! Just visit the customisation area - your items are still unlocked so just re-apply them

 Ketchup-based objectives are now much easier, thanks to reduced the Ketchup tolerance (yes that's a thing)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/94bed56b15000a832e0c1cec564789d1cf206a55.gif Champagne bottles now respawn correctly

 Left-handed mode was been tweaked. For example, chopsticks are now held correctly - as is the ring in the final level (shh!)

 Pepper and Salt UI has been changed to make each pot easier to identify

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/ffc34043f7fb19c530b91bfaf36a06484e5953bd.gif Arrow keys can now be binded from the settings menu

 Fixed an issue when the Achievement '#MagnumOps' (complete all levels in liquid of courage) was unlocked after rebooting the game

 Chopsticks are now easier to detach. When you use a chopstick, press the left-click to grab. When you see the rounded icon, that means the chopstick is about to detach. Press the left-click again to keep them.

 You can now pick up fish and other small items with utensils, just as nature intended!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35896139/742906d78810b8b2891875101675eece46cd1b54.gif

Additional fixes:
Ending level - champagne now respawns correctly
Level 4-3 - removed unexpected collision issue
Tutorial - fixed issue where the beer was not respawning
Fix issue on some levels where the data animation was making it harder for the player to complete the objective
Fix issue with save data not compatible with previous versions
Fix an issue where the player will get damaged if holding food for too long
Dating App - reduce the amount of repetitive message
Arrow keys can now be binded

Think this patch has improved the game? Then we'd love it if you updated your review on Steam!

Stay tuned to this channel for more updates as soon as we have them.

Lots of love,
Echo Chamber Games
